134758.overview: Final Fight X is probably the most conservative of Final Fight versions of OpenBOR, being much more faithful to Capcom's original work, so much so that we could almost consider it as the real Final Fight 2 instead of the game that was released for Super Nintendo. In Final Fight X you are able to choose between the three protagonists that appeared in the original game (Haggar, Guy and Cody) to overcome the different stages, in which they will face against all the enemies that appeared in the original title. Both graphically and playability, the game is a carbon copy of the original arcade, but with completely new stages.

210693.overview:
The world of Metro City like you've never seen before.The game was created by Machok through the OpenBoR engine. Here we find the handwriting of some of the best authors.However, the Machok compilation is unique. With its simplicity and lightness, Street Fighter 89 The Final Fight becomes an optimal remake of the highest quality. The units and sets are perfectly synchronized, and the simulation to the original game is perfect.
You will notice that all the elements are coordinated in detail so as to recreate the world of Capcom. What has been added is a wider world. You would say that these are the cut episodes and footage from Final Fight. But on the contrary, these are the missing episodes of the story and are completely original elements added by Machok. With them, the world of Metro City becomes wider, more voluminous, and the story more complete. So we can call the game Street Fighter 89 The Final Fight, an extended edition of Final Fight. Of course, there are many innovations, both in terms of decor and functional elements. Now, for example, the barrels are more difficult to break, there are levels that develop in a single-row martitsa, many elevators and niches where fighters come out. Other ornaments, such as Andore's whiskers, also create an interesting and entertaining atmosphere.
A number of new tunnels, corridors and ramps will create in you the feeling of a new and complete adventure that was once hidden from the fans.


the profile of Haggar: Street Fighter 89 The Final Fight is quite a difficult game and you will need skill to play it. You will have to train a lot. Of course, you can also use the cheats menu that comes with the OpenBoR console. it will make it easier for you by adding additional qualities to the characters. You can count on a total of three players and these are the classic Guy, Cody which is in two versions and Haggar.

216617.overview:
Final Fight Girls is developed by Kou30da based on Final Fight Alpha of S.E.E.P. made in the OpenBor engine. Like any Beat'em Up game, players must choose one of the available characters and cross the levels that refer to the game by hitting all the enemies that appear until the end of the game.

Final Fight Girls es desarrollado por kou30da basado en Final Fight Alpha de S.E.E.P. hecho en el motor OpenBOR. Como todo juego Beat'em Up, los jugadores deben elegir uno de los personajes disponibles y atravesar los niveles que se refieren al juego golpeando a todos los enemigos que aparecen hasta el final del juego.

216693.overview:
Fighting Street: Remixed is a fangame created by Ripfire based on Ericard's Street Fighter Ultimate Collection using OpenBOR. Actually for now, this game is more like an extension of Street Fighter One (Mugen). The game is still in development and future Versión will be completely independent from Ericard's Street Fighter Ultimate Collection with exclusive plot, enemies and combat system. Now finally 100% Dreamcast compatible! ;)

Source: https://www.dreamcast.es/infusions/forum/viewthread.php?thread_id=2921

216708.overview:
Fighting Street Hack Boss is an alternative version of Fighting Street by SEEP. Here you can play as all boss of Street Fighter 1 and have too many exclusive features. This “hack” is created as homage for all Street Fighter fans.t. ;)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Fighting Street Hack Boss es una versión alternativa de Fighting Street by SEEP . Aquí puedes jugar como todos los jefes de Street Fighter 1 y ademas contienes funciones exclusivas. Este "Bootleg" se crea como homenaje a todos los fans de Street Fighter. ;)

216763.overview: Mugen developer Mulambo's first OpenBOR creation, a modified Hyper Final Fight to create an all-original experience with original graphics.

216764.overview: This release features a special edition of Final Fight: The Last Round, Mr.Q's OpenBoR update to his Hyper Final Fight series, which doesn't need the RAM saving version of OpenBoR (bye bye long loading times!) and features three nice variants of the game.

217059.overview:
Fighting Street is a Street Fighter remake, the first part of the famous fighting video game saga created and launched Capcom in 1987. In fact, the name of this miming comes from the conversion of the original game made for the Turbo Grafx CD.

In this case, it is not a fighting game but a beat'em up starring Ryu and Ken who tells the phase of his training with Master Gouken. Then, the game will change between pure beat'em phases against groups of enemies and levels in a single plan with much of the platforms. At certain times you will even have to fight some enemies in the usual style 1 vs. 1.

In fact, the main characters can use some of their classic movements such as Shoryuken or Hadoken. Although Fighting Street is based on the characters and situations of the first game, some characters from other games such as the Fight Final Saga also appears, so although most graphics are adapted from the original game, many of the audiovisual resources have been created right from the start.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Fighting Street es un remake de Street Fighter, la primera parte de la famosa saga de videojuegos de lucha creada y lanzadapor Capcom en 1987. De hecho, el nombre de este fangame proviene de la conversión del juego original hecho para el Turbo Grafx CD.

En este caso, no se trata de un juego de lucha sino de un beat'em up protagonizado por Ryu y Ken que narra la fase de su entrenamiento con maestro Gouken. Entonces, el juego cambiará entre fases de beat'em puro contra grupos de enemigos y niveles en un solo planificar con gran parte de las plataformas. En ciertos momentos incluso tendrás que luchar contra algunos enemigos en el estilo habitual 1 vs 1.

De hecho, los personajes principales podrán utilizar algunos de sus movimientos clásicos como el Shoryuken o el Hadoken. Aunque Fighting Street se basa en los personajes y situaciones del primer juego, algunos personajes de otros juegos como de la saga Final Fight también aparece, así que aunque la mayoría de los gráficos están adaptados del juego original, muchos de los recursos audiovisuales se han creado desde cero.

219613.overview:
Final Fight Gold Super Extra is the latest known version of the Final Fight Gold series by Pierwolf, with additions by Don Drago and FinalFighter. The game combines the best of Street Fighter and Final Fight with a gritty aesthetic and Pierwolf's trademark level up system to create a unique blend of action and strategy. This final version is exclusive to Sega Dreamcast using the DreamBOR engine (OpenBOR for Sega DreamCast) by Ian Micheal.

Version 3.01 [2025-05-31]:
* For one / Two simultaneous players
* 24 chars from both Final Fight 1, 2, 3 and Super Street Fighter 2 Turbo + Extra aviable!
* New Modes & Soundtracks
* custom throws for all chars!
* all chars have 3 Special Moves and one Ultimate Move (see the HOW TO PLAY for the list)!
* 42 classic enemies and bosses!
* 28 BG, divided in 5 stages with multiple paths!
* Six classics bonus stages!
* New auction effect
* Level up (falsified)
* New mechanics in the game
* a classic boss mode, aviable when you beat the game the first time!
* a training mode, where you can train your moves!
* and some twist from the story of the original Final Fight!

219646.overview:
Tired of those chumps from more famous franchises stealing the spotlight? Here's your chance for revenge! Pick your favorite representative from Data East's lawyer bait flagship and take out your frustrations on a gang of even lessor known rivals.

Pick up a few friends from ADK along the way. Go for style - the more points you get, the stronger you become!

Fighters History: Revenge's developed by Pierwolf, Dupu and Ripfire with new characters, scenarios and many improvements and compatibility. The inclusion of new characters and scenarios that we could only dream of make it a fun game that you can try for free.

This fan game makes possible something like a remake of the game with which it is possible to spend hours of fun thanks to the OpenBor engine.

330237.overview:
Final Fight Alpha is another OpenBor games based on the Final Fight classic mixed with a bit of the Street Fighter Alpha Concept created by the ingenious Italian brothers "S.E.E.P.". This game includes 8 characters from Final Fight and Street Fighter Alpha, also soundtrack and sound of the 2 Capcom saga, as if it were little 8 new levels & new enemies.

This version is the final, it became a lot of changes to be functionable for Sega Dreamcast. The original SEEP's Final Fight Alpha game uses more than 25 mg of RAM, which is not functionable for Sega Dreamcast that its memory is 16 mg.

447860.overview: Created by Pablo Vera, this is a crossover of Capcom's two most nostalgic beat'em up games: Final Fight and Cadillacs & Dinosaurs. Two universes collide in this awesome adventure.

447863.overview: The follow up to Final Fight and Cadillacs, this offering refines the formula with better graphics, smoother game play, and a ton of additional features to enjoy. Try out some new weapons and guest fighters from other franchises.

453148.overview: Created by Seep team, this game reskins the orginal BOR to let you re-live the story of Fatal Fury. Take down the evil Geese Howard as Terry, Joe, Andy or Master Tung!

453195.overview: by special edition it means porn

453201.overview: Retro RPG turned into a beat'em up.

453204.overview: This take on Final Fight combines the original cast with new moves and new additions from the Street Fighter Alpha/Zero series. Try out alternate versions of Guy and Cody, take Maki for a spin, or choose one of the original bruisers to brawl your way through Metro City. Grab two of your buddies for 3 player co-op and show the Mad Gear Gang just what a mistake they've made!

453221.overview: Final Fight vs. nuclear war? Why not?! The classic trio team up with wrestler Scorpion of Slam Masters fame to avert a world ending catastrophe. This early OpenBOR module is one of, if not the first to feature four player action.

453843.overview: MrQ®'s last attempt of making a Final Fight mod for BoR engine is here in the Complete mods section. It features unique values for walkable areas in its stages, just like classic Beat'em up games. This version is for Sega DreamCast.

455225.overview: Final Fight Apocalypse: 2nd Edition [Remix Edition] is based off of (obviously) the Final Fight games, but you will recognize enemies and backgrounds from a whole assortment of different beat-em-ups. Featuring:4 playable characters - Haggar, Cody, Guy and Scorp (from Saturday Nite Slam Masters), 4-player simultaneous gameplay. Tons of special moves for each character, as well as useable weapons (uncommon for most BOR mods). Challenging enemies who block, teleport and won't hesitate to throw you around!

456222.overview: Think you've seen all Final Fight has to offer? Think again! Mr. Q brings his trademark production values and butter smooth gameplay to the Final Fight franchise and then gives it a kick in the Bay Area with dozens of nostalgic moves and an all new combo system.

456226.overview:
The fourth and final part of the saga...

After the events that occurred in Double Dragon Gaiden.

A great energy was released and the dragons are alerted to a new threat,

Enemies from all over gather to confront the dragons, but they recruit new and old allies to fight in this final battle...

463575.overview: Final Fight: The Last Round - Mr.Q's OpenBoR update to his Hyper Final Fight series - that doesn't need the RAM saving Versión of OpenBoR (bye bye long loading times!) and features three nice variants of the game. If you play the game on PC or other platforms you will only be able to play the FF3 Versión, but if you put the disc in your Dreamcast, you'll be able to play all three variants.
